actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Seed of the environment's random generator
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

inputs.description: Seed used by the next reset
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: seed

facts.text: The action space is a 4-element Box with each element from -1 to +1
step() requires a 4-element action, applies its first three elements through set_xyz_action and the last element through do_simulation
set_xyz_action clips every axis to [-1, 1] and multiplies it by action_scale before moving the mocap body
The observation is one flat 39-element array that concatenates the current state, the previous state and the goal position
The 18-element current state is the hand position (3), the gripper distance clipped to 0..1 and 14 padded object values
step() returns (observation, reward, terminated, truncated, info), terminated is always False and truncated becomes True at curr_path_length == max_path_length
step() advances self.frame_skip MuJoCo frames per environment step
The MuJoCo scene physics timestep is 0.0025 s
SawyerXYZEnv.reset(seed, options) ignores both arguments and resets curr_path_length to 0
seed(seed) seeds np_random and the action, observation and goal spaces
Meta-World/goal_observable is registered with an entry_point that selects the observable-goal class for env_name and passes seed=seed
The goal_observable constructor seeds numpy before construction and calls env.seed(seed) after the first reset when a seed is given
A successful assembly scores a reward of 10.0

determinism.notes: assembly-v3 is seeded at construction: Meta-World/goal_observable passes env_kwargs seed 0 into the wrapper, which seeds numpy before the scene is built and calls env.seed(seed) (metaworld/env_dict.py:184-199).  SawyerXYZEnv.reset ignores its seed argument (metaworld/sawyer_xyz_env.py:664-682), so cap.world.seed and the seed of cap.world.reset are recorded by the bridge but cannot reseed the upstream environment.  The fake is a fixed, deterministic stand-in and does not reseed either.

gaps: the F1 claim is the MuJoCo rigid-body scene of the task; there is no validated actuator, sensor or noise model and no hardware counterpart was measured
the physics timestep is 2.5 ms (basic_scene.xml:2) but step() advances frame_skip=5 frames, so one cap.world.step.v1 tick is a 12.5 ms control period; timestep_ms names the physics timestep (FID-015)
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, only commands advance simulated time

the fake backend is a pure-Python kinematics stand-in: it has no contacts, rigid-body dynamics, gripper or object motion, and was not compared with the upstream environment (metaworld, MuJoCo and numpy are not installed where the gate runs); it returns the declared 39-element observation
reset() ignores its seed argument upstream, so the bridge's seed control does not reseed the environment (see determinism.notes)
snapshot_restore is false: the environment has get_env_state/set_env_state, not the get_state/set_state pair the Gymnasium bridge snapshots

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
